s1.syndrome_frame: Acute left flank pain with cyclical fevers and cardiac mass
salient_findings: Large left ventricular mass on TTE and TEE
Malignant spindle cell tumor on pathology
key_facts: 22-year-old man with no significant medical history
1 day of acute left flank pain
Developed cyclical fevers while hospitalized
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase
Immunostains revealed malignant spindle cell tumor
Cytogenetics showed SS18 (SYT;18q11.2) translocation
Immunohistochemistry positive for epithelial membrane antigen (EMA)
Renal infarction on computed tomography
Large left ventricular mass on trans-thoracic echocardiography
Pedunculated LV mass emanating from the basal septum on TEE
Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging confirmed the mass location
Endomyocardial biopsies revealed malignant spindle cell tumor
